description: BigQuery views and tables with the TimesFM demand forecasts, the issue history they learn from, this week's rising Google searches in every hub market from the Google Trends public dataset, hub coordinates for the Google Maps Platform tools, contract freight per lane, the demand exposure of each hub's distribution zones, and place density by H3 cell in each hub market. Query them with the bq_execute_sql tool and always qualify them as dataset.table. They hold signals only, so take every on-hand, reservation, purchase order, supplier, and notification value from the Oracle EBS views.

tables.description: Daily demand forecast per hub and item for up to the next 14 days from BigQuery ML AI.FORECAST (TimesFM) on the issue history, multiplied by the hub market's rising search signal when one matches the item. A daily scheduled query refreshes it, and days before today drop out.

example_queries.description: TimesFM daily demand forecast for a hub and item
example_queries.sql: SELECT forecast_date, baseline_daily_burn_qty, lower_bound_qty, upper_bound_qty, search_surge_multiplier, surged_daily_burn_qty, top_rising_term, signal_source, demand_driver_summary FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code ORDER BY forecast_date

example_queries.description: Forecast summary: average baseline and surged daily demand over the horizon, with the search signal
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, item_code, COUNT(*) AS forecast_days, ROUND(AVG(baseline_daily_burn_qty), 2) AS avg_baseline_daily_burn_qty, ANY_VALUE(search_surge_multiplier) AS search_surge_multiplier, ROUND(AVG(surged_daily_burn_qty), 2) AS avg_surged_daily_burn_qty, ANY_VALUE(top_rising_term) AS top_rising_term, ANY_VALUE(signal_source) AS signal_source, ANY_VALUE(demand_driver_summary) AS demand_driver_summary FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code GROUP BY organization_code, item_code

example_queries.description: Stockout cliff and detection gap per hub and item: pass Oracle EBS ATT and MRP lead time as literals for one or more hub-items. Returns only hub-items that stock out within the 14-day forecast
example_queries.sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('<ORG_CODE>' AS organization_code, '<ITEM_CODE>' AS item_code, 0 AS att_qty, 0 AS lead_time_days)])), f AS (SELECT organization_code, item_code, forecast_date, surged_daily_burn_qty AS burn, search_surge_multiplier, top_rising_term, signal_source, demand_driver_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS day_n, SUM(surged_daily_burn_qty) OVER w AS cum_burn FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY organization_code, item_code ORDER BY forecast_date)), crossing AS (SELECT stock.organization_code, stock.item_code, stock.att_qty, stock.lead_time_days, MIN(f.day_n) AS stockout_day FROM stock JOIN f USING (organization_code, item_code) WHERE f.cum_burn >= stock.att_qty AND f.burn > 0 GROUP BY stock.organization_code, stock.item_code, stock.att_qty, stock.lead_time_days) SELECT crossing.organization_code, crossing.item_code, crossing.att_qty, crossing.lead_time_days, ROUND(f.day_n - 1 + (crossing.att_qty - (f.cum_burn - f.burn)) / f.burn, 2) AS days_to_stockout, f.forecast_date AS stockout_date, ROUND(crossing.lead_time_days - (f.day_n - 1 + (crossing.att_qty - (f.cum_burn - f.burn)) / f.burn), 2) AS detection_gap_days, f.search_surge_multiplier, f.top_rising_term, f.signal_source, f.demand_driver_summary FROM crossing JOIN f ON f.organization_code = crossing.organization_code AND f.item_code = crossing.item_code AND f.day_n = crossing.stockout_day ORDER BY days_to_stockout

example_queries.description: Safety stock check per hub and item: pass Oracle EBS safety stock and baseline safety stock as literals for one or more hub-items. Returns the surge target, the baseline scaled by the search surge multiplier or the baseline without a search surge, and whether to raise the safety stock, return it to the target, or keep it
example_queries.sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('<ORG_CODE>' AS organization_code, '<ITEM_CODE>' AS item_code, 0 AS safety_stock_qty, 0 AS baseline_safety_stock_qty)])), surge AS (SELECT organization_code, item_code, ANY_VALUE(search_surge_multiplier) AS search_surge_multiplier FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast GROUP BY organization_code, item_code), targets AS (SELECT stock.organization_code, stock.item_code, stock.safety_stock_qty, stock.baseline_safety_stock_qty, surge.search_surge_multiplier, IF(surge.search_surge_multiplier IS NULL, stock.baseline_safety_stock_qty, CAST(CEIL(stock.baseline_safety_stock_qty * surge.search_surge_multiplier) AS INT64)) AS surge_target_qty FROM stock JOIN surge USING (organization_code, item_code)) SELECT organization_code, item_code, safety_stock_qty, baseline_safety_stock_qty, search_surge_multiplier, surge_target_qty, CASE WHEN safety_stock_qty < surge_target_qty THEN 'Raise to target' WHEN safety_stock_qty > surge_target_qty THEN 'Return to target' WHEN safety_stock_qty = surge_target_qty THEN 'At target' END AS safety_stock_action FROM targets ORDER BY organization_code, item_code

example_queries.description: Projected ATT per forecast day for a stockout chart (pass ATT as a literal)
example_queries.sql: SELECT forecast_date, surged_daily_burn_qty, ROUND(:att_qty - SUM(surged_daily_burn_qty) OVER (ORDER BY forecast_date), 2) AS projected_att_qty FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code ORDER BY forecast_date

example_queries.description: Trailing 7-day average daily issues for the static days-of-cover baseline
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, item_code, ROUND(AVG(daily_issued_qty), 2) AS trailing_7d_daily_burn_qty FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_daily_issue_history WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code AND issue_date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(issue_date) FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_daily_issue_history WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY organization_code, item_code

example_queries.description: This week's rising searches in a hub market
example_queries.sql: SELECT term, rank, percent_gain, signal_source, demand_driver FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_search_signals WHERE organization_code = :org_code ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10

example_queries.description: Rank source hubs by net financial benefit for a transfer, using Oracle EBS ATT and item list price passed as literals. Returns the hub coordinates for the Routes and Weather tools
example_queries.sql: SELECT l.source_org_code, l.source_hub_name, h.att_qty, h.att_qty >= :transfer_qty AS sla_compliant, l.contract_freight_usd, ROUND(:transfer_qty * h.unit_list_price_usd, 2) AS protected_revenue_usd, ROUND(:transfer_qty * h.unit_list_price_usd - l.contract_freight_usd, 2) AS net_financial_benefit_usd, src.latitude AS source_latitude, src.longitude AS source_longitude, dst.latitude AS dest_latitude, dst.longitude AS dest_longitude FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.freight_lane_rates AS l JOIN UNNEST([STRUCT('<ORG_CODE>' AS organization_code, 0 AS att_qty, 0.0 AS unit_list_price_usd)]) AS h ON h.organization_code = l.source_org_code JOIN ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_market_areas AS src ON src.organization_code = l.source_org_code JOIN ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_market_areas AS dst ON dst.organization_code = l.dest_org_code WHERE l.dest_org_code = :dest_org_code ORDER BY sla_compliant DESC, net_financial_benefit_usd DESC

example_queries.description: Coordinates of hubs for the Routes and Weather tools
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, hub_name, latitude, longitude FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_market_areas WHERE organization_code IN (:org_codes)

example_queries.description: Most exposed distribution zones around a hub, with the Gemini pull-forward assessment
example_queries.sql: SELECT exposure_rank, zone_name, exposure_score, critical_care_sites, food_retail_sites, hardware_retail_sites, critical_care_level, food_retail_level, hardware_retail_level, owner_occupied_homes, distance_km, gemini_pull_forward_tier, gemini_reasoning FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.zone_demand_exposure WHERE organization_code = :org_code ORDER BY exposure_rank LIMIT 10

example_queries.description: Zone map rows (label, latitude, longitude, score) with the hub center and market radius for the zone map
example_queries.sql: SELECT e.zone_name AS label, ROUND(e.latitude, 4) AS latitude, ROUND(e.longitude, 4) AS longitude, e.exposure_score AS score, h.hub_name, h.latitude AS hub_latitude, h.longitude AS hub_longitude, e.market_radius_km FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.zone_demand_exposure e JOIN ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_market_areas h ON h.organization_code = e.organization_code WHERE e.organization_code = :org_code ORDER BY e.exposure_rank

example_queries.description: Split a hub's surged daily demand for an item across its most exposed zones (first forecast day)
example_queries.sql: WITH first_day AS (SELECT organization_code, surged_daily_burn_qty FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.timesfm_hub_burn_forecast WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code ORDER BY forecast_date LIMIT 1) SELECT e.exposure_rank, e.zone_name, first_day.surged_daily_burn_qty AS hub_surged_daily_qty, ROUND(first_day.surged_daily_burn_qty * e.exposure_share, 1) AS zone_surged_daily_qty FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.zone_demand_exposure e JOIN first_day ON first_day.organization_code = e.organization_code ORDER BY e.exposure_rank LIMIT 10

example_queries.description: Heatmap rows (h3_cell_index, score) for the densest cells around a hub, with the hub center and market radius
example_queries.sql: SELECT d.h3_cell_index, d.density_score AS score, h.hub_name, h.latitude AS hub_latitude, h.longitude AS hub_longitude, d.market_radius_km FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.market_place_density d JOIN ebs_scm_agentic_ai.hub_market_areas h ON h.organization_code = d.organization_code WHERE d.organization_code = :org_code ORDER BY d.density_rank LIMIT 80

example_queries.description: Densest cells around a hub with their place counts and centers
example_queries.sql: SELECT density_rank, h3_cell_index, latitude, longitude, distance_km, critical_care_sites, food_retail_sites, hardware_retail_sites, place_count, density_score FROM ebs_scm_agentic_ai.market_place_density WHERE organization_code = :org_code ORDER BY density_rank LIMIT 5
